Frequently Asked Questions 
 
Quick answers to common inquiries 
 
 
How do I become a member? 
 
Visit our Membership page to explore membership tiers and submit an application. We welcome national associations, producers, and industry professionals. 
 
 
 
How can I get certified? 
 
Our Education & Training programs offer certifications at multiple levels. Check the Programs page for current offerings and enrollment dates. 
 
 
 
When is the next annual conference? 
 
Our annual World Cheese Congress rotates locations each year. Subscribe to our newsletter or check the Events page for upcoming dates and registration. 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
Join the Global Cheese Community 
 
Connect with cheese professionals, researchers, and enthusiasts worldwide to advance the art and science of cheesemaking.
